violations.description: Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. -Using an unapproved sanitizer. Needs to be regular unscented bleach, quat or lactic acid.
Handling of clean equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not handled in a manner to prevent contamination of food-contact surface. Plates in the food prep area are not inverted.
